Title: NFR-01 risk engine answers under 40 ms at the 95th percentile

Step Action: Run scripts/benchmark_risk_eval.ps1 on a warm stack
Step Expected: p95 is under 40 ms

Title: NFR-02 concurrent transfers from one account never overdraw it

Step Action: Run scripts/run_jmeter_test.ps1
Step Expected: The run completes with no 5xx from the ledger

Step Action: Read the balance and the statement
Step Expected: The balance is never negative and equals the opening balance minus the posted transfers

Title: NFR-03 A to B and B to A at the same moment do not deadlock

Step Action: Send transfers 1 to 2 and 2 to 1 in parallel, repeated 50 times
Step Expected: All finish; none hangs or fails on a lock timeout

Step Action: Read both balances
Step Expected: Each equals its opening balance plus the net of the posted transfers

Title: NFR-04 two transfers near the daily limit at the same moment cannot both pass

Step Action: Send two transfers in parallel that fit the remaining limit one at a time but not together
Step Expected: One is POSTED; the other is FAILED with LIMIT_EXCEEDED

Title: NFR-05 end of day completes in 5 to 8 seconds

Step Action: As admin, trigger end of day on seed data and time it
Step Expected: COMPLETED in 5 to 8 seconds

Title: NFR-06 the first transfer on an idle stack still posts

Step Action: Leave the stack idle for 30 minutes, then send one transfer
Step Expected: POSTED, not FAILED with RISK_UNAVAILABLE

Title: NFR-07 risk engine too slow or down: the transfer is declined before any hold

Step Action: Stop risk-engine (or delay it past 150 ms) and send a transfer
Step Expected: FAILED with RISK_UNAVAILABLE

Step Action: Read the sender balance and held amount
Step Expected: Unchanged; no hold was placed

Title: NFR-08 Redis down: the risk engine refuses to decide

Step Action: Stop Redis and send a transfer with a token issued earlier
Step Expected: The risk engine answers 503 RISK_UNAVAILABLE and the transfer is FAILED before any hold

Step Action: Start Redis and send a transfer
Step Expected: POSTED

Title: NFR-09 ledger unreachable before the hold: the transfer fails cleanly

Step Action: Stop ledger-service and send a transfer
Step Expected: FAILED with LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE

Step Action: Start the ledger and read the balance
Step Expected: Unchanged

Title: NFR-10 ledger unreachable after the hold: the transfer waits and then finishes

Step Action: Stop ledger-service after the hold is placed
Step Expected: The transaction stays PROCESSING at its stage and is visible to staff

Step Action: Start the ledger and wait for the sweep
Step Expected: The transfer reaches a final status and the money moved exactly once or not at all

Title: NFR-11 orchestration restarts in the middle of a saga

Step Action: Send a transfer and restart orchestration-service before it finishes
Step Expected: The service comes back

Step Action: Poll the transaction
Step Expected: It continues from its last state to a final status; the money moved exactly once

Title: NFR-12 Kafka down: postings still commit and events are sent later

Step Action: Stop Kafka and make a cash deposit
Step Expected: The deposit is accepted and the balance changes; the event waits in OUTBOX

Step Action: Start Kafka
Step Expected: The relay publishes the event and the notification arrives

Title: NFR-13 audit store down: no balance changes without an audit row

Step Action: Stop the audit PostgreSQL and make a cash deposit
Step Expected: The deposit fails

Step Action: Start it and read the balance
Step Expected: Unchanged

Title: NFR-14 a service that is down gives 503 in the standard shape

Step Action: Stop customer-service and GET /api/v1/customers/me through the gateway
Step Expected: HTTP 503 with the problem shape and an errorCode

Title: NFR-15 link between cloud and on-premises is cut

Step Action: Block the peering link with a firewall rule
Step Expected: The rule is in place

Step Action: Sign in
Step Expected: Sign-in still works

Step Action: Send a transfer
Step Expected: It fails cleanly or waits in PROCESSING; no balance is half-changed

Step Action: Remove the rule and send a transfer
Step Expected: POSTED; anything left in PROCESSING reaches a final status

Title: NFR-16 batch survives a ledger outage and can be run again

Step Action: Stop ledger-service and trigger end of day (scripts/test_batch_report_and_recovery.ps1)
Step Expected: The current step fails and the run is FAILED

Step Action: Start the ledger and trigger again
Step Expected: COMPLETED; nothing is posted twice

Title: NFR-17 batch halts when debits do not equal credits

Step Action: Precondition: on a throwaway stack, make the day debits differ from the credits
Step Expected: The imbalance exists

Step Action: Trigger end of day
Step Expected: Step 5 FAILED, step 6 SKIPPED, run HALTED, and the admin is alerted

Title: NFR-18 an account short of money for a fee or instalment does not stop the batch

Step Action: Precondition: one qualifying account has less than the fee
Step Expected: Balance noted

Step Action: Trigger end of day
Step Expected: That item is recorded as failed; the step continues and the run is COMPLETED

Title: NFR-19 monitoring raises an alert when a service is down

Step Action: Run scripts/test_observability_and_alerts.ps1, or stop one service
Step Expected: The dashboard shows the service down and the alert fires

Step Action: Start the service
Step Expected: The alert clears
